title: Hussmann Corporation - proposed acquisition of Austral Refrigeration Holdings Pty Ltd

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: Hussmann proposed to acquire Austral's commercial refrigeration business. As part of the transaction, Woolworths proposed to acquire Hussmann's Australian maintenance and service business assets.
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered the proposed acquisition in the context of the following markets: i. The national market for the manufacture and supply of remote refrigerated display cases; ii. The national market for the design and installation of remote refrigeration systems; and iii. Region-based markets for the maintenance of remote commercial refrigeration systems.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC considered that the proposed acquisitions were unlikely to substantially lessen competition in any relevant market. Factors informing this view included: i. in each relevant market, a number of actual and potential alternatives existed that would continue to competitively constrain the merged entities; and ii. barriers to entry and expansion did not appear significant.
